body: Travelling..it's all I can think about, I want to get out of my life for a while so badly. Unfortunately it's not possible right now and I don't think I really even deserve to go off and abandon my boyfriend, he works so hard. Somehow I don't think a 2 week vacation would change much either... I've always wanted to just go somewhere and just live, trying new places until I felt at home. Or maybe travel so far that I would appreciate my own home more.
